2014: Can't see; automatically fails ability checks that require sight.
Attack rolls against the creature have advantage; its attack rolls have disadvantage.
2024: Can't see; automatically fails ability checks that require sight.
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage; its attack rolls have Disadvantage.

2014: Can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with harmful abilities or magical effects.
The charmer has advantage on ability checks to interact socially with the creature.
2024: Can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with damaging abilities or magical effects.
The charmer has Advantage on ability checks to interact socially with the creature.

2014: Can't hear; automatically fails ability checks that require hearing.
2024: Can't hear; automatically fails ability checks that require hearing.

2014: Six cumulative levels: 1—Disadvantage on ability checks; 2—Speed halved; 3—Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
Level 4—Hit Point maximum halved; 5—Speed 0; 6—death.
A Long Rest can remove one level if food and drink are available.
2024: Each application adds one Exhaustion level (maximum 6; level 6 causes death).
Subtract twice the Exhaustion level from all D20 Tests and reduce Speed by 5 feet per level.
A Long Rest removes one level; the condition ends at level 0.

2014: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight.
Can't willingly move closer to the source of fear.
2024: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is in line of sight.
Can't willingly move closer to the source of fear.

2014: Speed is 0, with no benefits from bonuses to Speed.
The condition ends if the grappler becomes Incapacitated or if an effect moves the target out of the grappler's reach.
2024: Speed is 0 and can't increase.
Attack rolls against anyone other than the grappler have Disadvantage.
The grappler can drag or carry the creature, with extra movement cost except when the target is Tiny or at least two sizes smaller.

2014: Can't take actions or Reactions.
Any existing Concentration ends.
2024: Can't take actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions; Concentration ends.
Can't speak; has Disadvantage on Initiative if already Incapacitated when it is rolled.

2014: Can't be seen without magic or a special sense; counts as heavily obscured for hiding.
Attack rolls against the creature have disadvantage, and its attack rolls have advantage.
2024: Advantage on Initiative rolls while Invisible.
Effects that require sight of the target don't affect the creature unless the creator can somehow see it; carried equipment is concealed.
Attack rolls against the creature have Disadvantage, and its own have Advantage, unless the other creature can see it.

2014: Also Incapacitated; can't move or speak.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws; attack rolls against the creature have advantage.
An attack that hits from within 5 feet is a critical hit.
2024: Also Incapacitated; Speed is 0 and can't increase.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws; attack rolls against the creature have Advantage.
An attack that hits from within 5 feet is a Critical Hit.

2014: Transformed into solid substance with nonmagical gear; weight increases tenfold, aging stops.
Incapacitated, immobile and unaware; attack rolls against it have advantage and it automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Resistance to all damage; immune to poison and disease (existing poison or disease is suspended).
2024: The creature and its nonmagical possessions turn into solid material; weight increases tenfold, and aging stops.
Incapacitated; Speed 0; attack rolls against it have Advantage; it automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Resistance to all damage; immunity to the Poisoned condition.

2014: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
2024: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

2014: Can crawl or spend half Speed to stand; can't stand if Speed is 0.
Disadvantage on own attack rolls. Attacks against it have advantage within 5 feet, otherwise disadvantage.
2024: Can crawl or spend movement equal to half Speed to stand; can't stand if Speed is 0.
Disadvantage on own attack rolls. Attacks against it have Advantage within 5 feet, otherwise Disadvantage.

2014: Speed is 0 and can't increase.
Attacks against the creature have advantage, its attack rolls have disadvantage, and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
2024: Speed is 0 and can't increase.
Attacks against the creature have Advantage, its attack rolls have Disadvantage, and it has Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

2014: Also Incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws; attack rolls against the creature have advantage.
2024: Also Incapacitated.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws; attack rolls against the creature have Advantage.

2014: Also Incapacitated and Prone; drops what it's holding, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings.
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws; attacks against it have advantage.
An attack that hits from within 5 feet is a critical hit.
2024: Also Incapacitated and Prone; drops what it's holding and remains Prone when Unconscious ends.
Speed is 0; attacks against it have Advantage; it automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
An attack that hits from within 5 feet is a Critical Hit; the creature is unaware of its surroundings.
